title: Fix UI and contrast audit findings (header theme toggle, accent-button contrast, slate-400 labels, leaf chips, duplicate level codes, pricing card, dictionary reading duplication)

spec.problem: 2026-11-21 Kiokoto production audit found UI/contrast defects in apps/web: no header theme toggle (dark theme only reachable from post-login settings), white text on bg-accent small buttons (3.68 light / 2.54 dark), light-mode text-slate-400 tiny labels (3.0), text-leaf on bg-leaf-soft chips (3.58) and text-sakura on bg-sakura-soft (4.41), duplicated BJT level codes (J5J5 — Sơ cấp), pricing feature lines without a space after the colon and a free card repeating its name as price, and a dictionary reading rendered as (たいらしょうねじ-)たいらしょうねじ.

acceptance.text: AC1: Header shows a working theme toggle for guests (and signed-in users); toggling switches .dark/data-theme and persists via the existing appearance mechanism; covered by a test.
AC2: No bg-accent text-white small-text occurrence below 4.5 in either theme; the extended contrast regression test scans all tsx and passes.
AC3: The identified slate-400 text labels are >=4.5 in light mode (slate-500 or equivalent), unchanged in dark.
AC4: leaf-on-leaf-soft chips >=4.5 in light mode, unchanged in dark (same treatment for sakura-on-sakura-soft chips).
AC5: Levels UI shows each level code once per heading/tab.
AC6: Pricing feature lines render with a space after the colon in vi/ja/en; free card no longer duplicates its name as price.
AC7: Dictionary list no longer duplicates readings for the affected pattern, and the data-affected count is reported.
AC8: pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-433 CLOSED via the harness; git status shows only intended files.

spec.expected_behavior: A sun/moon header toggle (guests and signed-in users) switches .dark/data-theme via lib/appearance saveAppearance and, when signed in, persists through the same PUT /api/auth/me call the settings page uses; filled accent controls use bg-action (>=4.5 in both themes) and the contrast regression scans all tsx; the identified slate-400 labels use slate-500 in light (dark unchanged); soft leaf/sakura chips use new leaf-strong/sakura-strong text tokens (light #047857/#b91c1c, dark = existing leaf/sakura); each level code renders once per heading/card; pricing quota lines render as one i18n-formatted run "{label}: {value}" in vi/ja/en and the free card shows 0đ instead of repeating its name; the dictionary list/detail collapse the duplicated parenthesized reading prefix (data count reported, data untouched).
spec.observed_behavior: Header has only the language switcher; 27 bg-accent+text-white controls fail AA; homepage level/news labels use slate-400 in light mode; leaf/sakura soft chips use the base token text; levels home card, /levels card and level detail render the code next to an API name that already starts with the code; pricing quota lines split label, ": " and value into separate flex text runs and the free card shows "Miễn phí" twice; one dictionary entry ((-)平小ねじ) has a source reading with a duplicated parenthesized prefix.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the WEB-433 web-only commit; no data, API or schema changes.
